sources.name: TfL Improving London Overground
sources.fact: Barking Riverside station opened July 2022; 4.5km extension; Barking in 7 minutes; central London as little as 22 minutes

sources.name: TfL Borough three-year report
sources.fact: historic 10800-home masterplan; no more than 4000 homes occupied without Overground extension; extension unlocked remaining 6800

sources.name: TfL DLR Beckton Riverside Thamesmead consultation
sources.fact: consultation closed 2026-07-16; update 2026-07-17; TWA application planned early 2027; construction could begin 2029 subject to permission and funding; opening potentially early 2030s

sources.name: TfL Barking station
sources.fact: Suffragette line serves Barking Riverside from Barking

sources.name: London Riverside Opportunity Area
sources.fact: adopted OA; potential 44000 homes and 29000 jobs by 2041; key transport includes Barking Riverside Overground

sources.name: Royal Docks and Beckton Riverside OA
sources.fact: adopted OAPF 2023; with transport improvements potential 36300 homes and 55700 jobs; supports proposed DLR extension

sources.name: Mayor of London Homes Barking Riverside
sources.fact: updated 2026 outline consent capacity 20000 homes; 4000 affordable; around 3000 completed; consented

sources.name: LBBD Inclusive Growth infrastructure and transport
sources.fact: Infrastructure Delivery Plan assesses current provision and future requirements; LIP3 and Transport Strategy support growth

sources.name: LBBD Local Plan
sources.fact: adopted plan includes infrastructure and facilities needed for growth

sources.name: LBBD Development Plan
sources.fact: London Plan and Barking and Dagenham 2037 Local Plan form development-plan framework

sources.name: GLA MD1625 Barking Riverside Extension
sources.fact: historic project decision linked Overground extension to 10800-home Barking Riverside baseline and wider regeneration

sources.name: Planning Data LBBD adopted Local Plan
sources.fact: adopted 2024-09-18; required housing 38864 through plan period

examples: Barking Riverside Overground is operational infrastructure, opened July 2022

London Riverside OA strategic potential is 44000 homes and 29000 jobs by 2041
